verified: CoinDesk reported that the Solana Foundation has taken a majority interest in CoinGecko, and described CoinGecko as one of the crypto ecosystem's most popular price-tracking platforms.
unconfirmed: the deal value, the exact percentage acquired, the structure of the transaction, and any commitments about CoinGecko's independence; the 18 million registered-user figure is CoinGecko's own reported number, and no party outside the report has confirmed the deal's terms.

verified: 据 CoinDesk 报道，Solana 基金会已持有 CoinGecko 的多数权益；CoinGecko 是加密领域主要的行情追踪平台之一，其自称拥有 1800 万注册用户。
unconfirmed: 交易金额、持股比例、估值、是否全部以 SOL 或现金支付，以及数据与接口政策是否调整，均未见披露，仅有 CoinDesk 单一信源报道，暂无独立确认。

titles.en: Solana Foundation takes majority stake in CoinGecko
titles.zh: Solana 基金会取得 CoinGecko 多数股权，后者有 1800 万注册用户
